dialogue_texts: My, that was quite a lively dance.
However, the true source of this perpetual darkness still lingers ahead, doesn't it?
That was only one; we still have the other.
We shouldn't go in until the others are dealt with.
Step out from the shadows of the night, Ryuuko.
Your presence is disrupting an otherwise lovely evening.
When we have a glohmed maid, all our wishes come true.
Berenice is the one who gave us her.
What's going on? Has she recovered from her injuries?
Why are you asking me that question? I can't answer that.
If you won't speak, I suppose my danmaku will have to coax the truth out of you.
There will always be ways for us to outsmart you.
She never succeeded in locking me up...
And I escaped before that witch laid a finger on me.
Tell us the truth, or else.
